name: B10-0164/2025 (Renew) – The need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Syria rebuild after the fall of the Assad family's rule. It asks for more humanitarian and development aid, support for rebuilding transport, electricity, healthcare and education, and a gradual lifting of sanctions. It wants a political transition that includes women, civil society and all religious and ethnic groups, and it urges other countries to respect Syria's borders. The text is a set of requests and opinions, not a law, so nothing changes automatically.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the EU to give more aid, ease sanctions and support rebuilding.
- **Who it affects:** Syrians, Syrian refugees, EU aid budgets and companies trading with Syria.
- **What happens next:** The EU and its member states decide whether to act on these requests.
